newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power Monday price offers unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power Monday price offers unchanged.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration left price offers for Monday unchanged from Friday's levels, while weekend prices were adjusted only to reflect the usual lack of peak-demand periods.
Monday prices for peak-hour sales between 0800 and 2100 PDT were unchanged at $20.00 per MWh ($19.00 non-firm). Off-peak prices were also steady at $15.00 ($14.00 non-firm).
Shoulder hour prices continued to be split between $17.00 for hours ending 0600 and 2400 ($16.00 non-firm) and $18.00 for hours ending 0700, 2200 and 2300 ($17.00 non-firm).
Early morning hour prices on Saturday and Sunday were the same as Monday, but the high end for prices was $18.50 for hours 0800-2300 PDT on Saturday and $18.00 on Sunday.
In addition, sales volumes during 0800-2300 PDT on Sunday were limited to 500 MW.
